hero.name: MD Meraju Islam
hero.title: Motion Designer & Creative Developer
hero.tagline: I turn ideas into motion, pixels into stories, and repetitive tasks into one-click scripts.

story.lede: I'm a self-taught motion designer and developer from Bangladesh who believes great design should move — literally.
paragraphs: What started as curiosity in After Effects turned into a full-blown obsession with motion graphics, visual effects, and creative automation. I've spent years learning the craft — not through courses, but by breaking things, rebuilding them, and sharing what I figured out along the way.

Today I work on a mix of client projects and personal experiments: title animations for brands, surreal composites, PowerShell tools that save hours of busywork, and After Effects expressions that solve problems nobody else seems to have solved yet.
This portfolio is a living archive of that work. Every project here is something I actually built — no mockups, no concept art that never shipped. If it's here, it ran.

process.title: Understand
process.desc: Every project starts with a conversation. What are you trying to say? Who's watching? What should they feel? I sketch rough directions before touching any software.

process.title: Design
process.desc: Mood boards, style frames, and motion tests. I nail the look in still frames first, then figure out how it moves. This is where most of the creative decisions happen.

process.title: Animate
process.desc: Keyframes, expressions, and a lot of timeline scrubbing. This is the fun part — watching static frames come alive. I render low-res previews constantly to check timing.

process.title: Deliver
process.desc: Final render, organized project files, and documentation. I hand over clean AE projects with named layers, not a mess of 'Untitled Composition 7.'

journey.title: First After Effects project
journey.desc: A 10-second logo reveal for a school event. It took 6 hours. I was hooked.

journey.title: Started freelancing
journey.desc: Social media kits, YouTube thumbnails, and intros for small creators. Learned to work fast and communicate clearly.

journey.title: Discovered automation
journey.desc: Wrote my first PowerShell script to batch-rename 200 files. Realized creative automation is its own art form.

journey.title: Built MERAJXO
journey.desc: Designed and developed my own portfolio app in Flutter — the one you're looking at right now. Manager app + portfolio, fully self-hosted on GitHub.

journey.title: Sharing back
journey.desc: Started publishing After Effects expressions, scripts, and design resources for other creators to use freely.

contact.intro: Have a project in mind? I work with brands, creators, and studios on motion graphics, visual effects, and creative automation. Drop me a line — I usually reply within a day.
